standard.name: agentskills
standard.note: The rules in bin/lib/rules.mjs mirror the spec at this hash. Re-pinning is a deliberate act after reconciling the mirror rule by rule; kaal standard says whether the live text still matches.

validator.note: The standard's own reference validator, run over skills/ by the ci workflow's standard job; re-pin with the spec.

gates.evidence: the ask itself, in the requirement's opening line

gates.act: approves the drawing before code is written
gates.evidence: the drawing with its seams, decisions and red contract tests
gates.recorded: the merge of the drawing's pull request

gates.act: gives the key for one release to one target
gates.evidence: a green board and the release plan

gates.name: acceptance
gates.fix: make the criterion true or hand it back; close a green requirement; give every requirement a status

gates.name: contracts
gates.fix: keep the seam's promise or hand it back; a drawing reads its task's status from its requirement

gates.name: units
gates.fix: fix the unit; never edit the test to pass

gates.name: rules
gates.fix: obey the skill rules (name, description, MIT, budget, depth, no vendor, no dash)

gates.name: drawings
gates.fix: give the drawing the template's six sections in order, one labelled edge and one contract test per seam, every criterion in the strategy table, and a requirement of the same task

gates.name: traces
gates.fix: declare what the artefact came from, and make every name resolve

gates.name: ledger
gates.fix: evidence the rung or lower it

gates.name: boundary
gates.fix: keep the write, the shell and the network out of bin/lib/assess; only output.mjs may write

gates.name: reads
gates.fix: a retro's Read line names a skill this tree does not hold: correct the name, or drop the line if the skill it meant is gone

gates.name: class
gates.fix: put the version back: only a human moves the minor or the major place. A tree with no base ref answers that the question is not its own

gates.name: format
gates.fix: npx prettier --write . (npm install first if the formatter is missing)

gates.name: coverage
gates.fix: nothing to fix: a coverage row is a fact about how far the work has got, and this wall cannot refuse

gates.name: seats
gates.fix: split the diff or rename the branch to the lane it belongs to; never widen the declaration to let a diff through
